mission.objective: Execute a separately registered curated-release CA1/DG predictive benchmark, conditional on scientific gates; preserve stopped evidence if a critical gate fails.

requirements: Require 8 eligible mice per group and 5 units per subfield
Execute M2-M7 only after preceding gates pass
Stop and prepare saved-evidence closeout on critical failure
constraints: No P1-P11, original P12 or native-support edits
No neural mechanism, independent histology or lossless exposure claims
